ROW.COLUMN: (IML/CU) Trades in Securities with Near-Term Maturity, Exchange of Assets

Money launderers use a variety of layering techniques to obscure the source of their assets and foster the impression that these assets were derived lawfully. One layering strategy involves creating the appearance that assets from illicit activities are actually proceeds from investments. This may be accomplished by intentionally establishing positions in securities that are subject to near-term payout or exchange of assets. The asset is returned to the client within a short period, either in a monetary form or as a fungible asset. This situation can provide the appearance of legitimacy because the resultant funds are derived from an investment. This scenario identifies customers who demonstrate a pattern of entering into positions in securities that, in the near-term, are due to mature, expire, or be switched into another security as the result of a corporate action

This scenario identifies money launders that have some illicit money and want to show that money as legal. The launderer will invest that money into a near term maturity security and after that security has expired ,he will show the near term payout that it has received from sale proceeds of security and give an impression that the money has been derived from investment in a security
Near-term maturity securities are ones that are due to expire, mature, or be switched into another security. It is calculated by taking the difference between the corporate effective date or the maturity date and the trade date (for finding the date when the trade was made for the said security) .The difference between these two is considered a near-term.

SELECT c.CUST_INTRL_ID, dt.d_Clndr_Dt FROM @BUSINESS@.CUST c inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT a on c.CUST_INTRL_ID = a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID inner join @BUSINESS@.TRADE_SMRY_VW t on a.ACCT_INTRL_ID = t.LAST_CUST_ACCT_INTRL_ID inner join @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL cal on t.TRADE_DT = cal.CLNDR_DT inner join @MINER@.DSVIEW115200450 dt on 1 = 1 WHERE ( a.MANTAS_ACCT_HOLDR_TYPE_CD = 'CI' and a.MANTAS_ACCT_BUS_TYPE_CD in (@MantasBusAcctType) and NVL(t.TRADE_PURP_CD, 'NULL') not in (@ExcTradePurpCd) and ('Y' = @AllJurisdictionsFl or c.JRSDCN_CD in (@InclJurisdictionsLst)) and c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 and t.CUST_OPEN_CLOS_POSN_CD = 'O' and cal.BUS_DAY_AGE between 0 and (@LookbackPeriod - 1) and cal.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and cal.BUS_DAY_FL = 'Y' and ('Y' = @AllAcctTypesFl or a.ACCT_TYPE1_CD in (@IncludedAcctTypeLst)) )
SELECT a.CLNDR_DT, a.CLNDR_DAY_AGE, F_TO_NUMBER(NVL(F_DATE_TO_CHAR(a.CLNDR_DT,'J'),'0')) d_Clndr_Dt FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL a WHERE (a.CLNDR_NM='SYSCAL' and a.CLNDR_DAY_AGE=0)

SELECT F_TO_NUMBER(NVL(F_DATE_TO_CHAR(t.TRADE_DT, 'J'), '0')) d_Last_Data_Dmp_Dt, t.TRADE_SEQ_ID, c.CUST_INTRL_ID FROM @BUSINESS@.CUST c inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT a on c.CUST_INTRL_ID = a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID inner join @BUSINESS@.TRADE_SMRY_VW t on a.ACCT_INTRL_ID = t.LAST_CUST_ACCT_INTRL_ID inner join @BUSINESS@.SCRTY s on s.SCRTY_INTRL_ID = t.SCRTY_INTRL_ID inner join @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL cal on cal.CLNDR_DT = t.TRADE_DT WHERE ( a.MANTAS_ACCT_HOLDR_TYPE_CD = 'CI' and a.MANTAS_ACCT_BUS_TYPE_CD in (@MantasBusAcctType) and t.CUST_OPEN_CLOS_POSN_CD = 'O' and NVL(t.TRADE_PURP_CD, 'NULL') not in (@ExcTradePurpCd) and ('Y' = @AllJurisdictionsFl or c.JRSDCN_CD in (@InclJurisdictionsLst)) and c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 and s.PROD_CTGRY_CD not in (@ExcPrdctCtgryCd) and s.PROD_CTGRY_CD = 'FI' and s.DRVTV_MTRTY_XPRTN_DT <= ADD_DAYS(t.TRADE_DT, @NearTermDtFI) and s.DRVTV_MTRTY_XPRTN_DT >= t.TRADE_DT and cal.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and cal.BUS_DAY_AGE between 0 and (@LookbackPeriod - 1) and cal.BUS_DAY_FL = 'Y' and ('Y' = @AllAcctTypesFl or a.ACCT_TYPE1_CD in (@IncludedAcctTypeLst)) )

SELECT F_TO_NUMBER(NVL(F_DATE_TO_CHAR(trv.TRADE_DT, 'J'), '0')) d_Last_Data_Dmp_Dt, trv.TRADE_SEQ_ID, cust.CUST_INTRL_ID FROM @BUSINESS@.CUST cust inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT acc on cust.CUST_INTRL_ID = acc.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID inner join @BUSINESS@.TRADE_SMRY_VW trv on acc.ACCT_INTRL_ID = trv.LAST_CUST_ACCT_INTRL_ID inner join @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL cal on cal.CLNDR_DT = trv.TRADE_DT inner join @BUSINESS@.SCRTY s on trv.SCRTY_INTRL_ID = s.SCRTY_INTRL_ID --21118503 inner join @MARKET@.SCRTY_MKT_DAILY bsmd on s.BASE_SCRTY_INTRL_ID = bsmd.SCRTY_INTRL_ID and trv.TRADE_DT = bsmd.MKT_DT inner join @MARKET@.SCRTY_MKT_DAILY osmd on s.SCRTY_INTRL_ID = osmd.SCRTY_INTRL_ID and trv.TRADE_DT = osmd.MKT_DT
WHERE ( acc.MANTAS_ACCT_HOLDR_TYPE_CD = 'CI' and acc.MANTAS_ACCT_BUS_TYPE_CD in (@MantasBusAcctType) and trv.CUST_OPEN_CLOS_POSN_CD = 'O' and NVL(trv.TRADE_PURP_CD, 'NULL') not in (@ExcTradePurpCd) and ('Y' = @AllJurisdictionsFl or cust.JRSDCN_CD in (@InclJurisdictionsLst)) and cust.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 and s.PROD_CTGRY_CD not in (@ExcPrdctCtgryCd) and s.PROD_CTGRY_CD = 'OPT' and s.DRVTV_MTRTY_XPRTN_DT <= ADD_DAYS(trv.TRADE_DT, @NearTermDtOPT) and s.DRVTV_MTRTY_XPRTN_DT >= trv.TRADE_DT and cal.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and cal.BUS_DAY_AGE between 0 and (@LookbackPeriod - 1) and cal.BUS_DAY_FL = 'Y' --21118503 and ( (s.OPTNS_CALL_PUT_CD = 'C' and NVL(bsmd.MKT_CLS_BASE_PR, 0) - NVL(osmd.OPTNS_STRK_BASE_PR,0) >= 0) or (s.OPTNS_CALL_PUT_CD = 'P' and NVL(osmd.OPTNS_STRK_BASE_PR, 0) - NVL(bsmd.MKT_CLS_BASE_PR, 0) >= 0) and osmd.MKT_DT <= osmd.OPTNS_STRK_BASE_PR_DT ) and ('Y' = @AllAcctTypesFl or acc.ACCT_TYPE1_CD in (@IncludedAcctTypeLst)) )

--25457821 SELECT sub.CUST_INTRL_ID, sub.PROD_CTGRY_CD, sub.TRADE_SEQ_ID, sub.TRADE_DT, sub.Max_Trd_Dump_Dt, sub.Tot_CA_Ct, sub.Min_CA_Effctv_Dt, sub.Max_CA_Effctv_Dt, sub.FI_Fl, sub.Opt_Fl FROM
(SELECT distinct s.PROD_CTGRY_CD, trv.TRADE_SEQ_ID, trv.TRADE_DT, max(trv.LAST_DATA_DUMP_DT) over (partition by cust.CUST_INTRL_ID) as Max_Trd_Dump_Dt, count(distinct ca.CORP_ACTN_SEQ_ID) over (partition by cust.CUST_INTRL_ID) as Tot_CA_Ct, min(ca.CORP_ACTN_EFCTV_DT) over (partition by cust.CUST_INTRL_ID) as Min_CA_Effctv_Dt, max(ca.CORP_ACTN_EFCTV_DT) over (partition by cust.CUST_INTRL_ID) as Max_CA_Effctv_Dt, CASE WHEN s.PROD_CTGRY_CD = 'FI' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FI_Fl, CASE WHEN s.PROD_CTGRY_CD = 'OPT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END Opt_Fl, cust.CUST_INTRL_ID FROM @BUSINESS@.CUST cust inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT acc on cust.CUST_INTRL_ID = acc.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID inner join @BUSINESS@.TRADE_SMRY_VW trv on acc.ACCT_INTRL_ID = trv.LAST_CUST_ACCT_INTRL_ID inner join @BUSINESS@.SCRTY s on trv.SCRTY_INTRL_ID = s.SCRTY_INTRL_ID inner join @BUSINESS@.CORP_ACTN ca on s.SCRTY_INTRL_ID = ca.SCRTY_INTRL_ID WHERE acc.MANTAS_ACCT_HOLDR_TYPE_CD = 'CI' and acc.MANTAS_ACCT_BUS_TYPE_CD in (@MantasBusAcctType) and trv.CUST_OPEN_CLOS_POSN_CD = 'O' and NVL(trv.TRADE_PURP_CD, 'NULL') not in (@ExcTradePurpCd) and ('Y' = @AllJurisdictionsFl or cust.JRSDCN_CD in (@InclJurisdictionsLst)) and cust.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 and s.PROD_CTGRY_CD not in (@ExcPrdctCtgryCd) and s.PROD_CTGRY_CD in (@IncPrdctCtgryCdCA) and F_TO_NUMBER(NVL(F_DATE_TO_CHAR(ca.CORP_ACTN_EFCTV_DT, 'J'), '0')) - F_TO_NUMBER(NVL(F_DATE_TO_CHAR(trv.TRADE_DT, 'J'), '0')) between 0 and @NearTermDtCA and ca.CORP_ACTN_TYPE_CD in (@IncActionTypeCA) and ('Y' = @AllAcctTypesFl or acc.ACCT_TYPE1_CD in (@IncludedAcctTypeLst)) and trv.TRADE_DT in (select cal.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL cal where cal.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and cal.BUS_DAY_FL = 'Y' and cal.BUS_DAY_AGE between 0 and @LookbackPeriod - 1) ) sub WHERE sub.Max_Trd_Dump_Dt in (select cal.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL cal where cal.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and cal.CLNDR_DAY_AGE between 0 and @FrequencyPeriod - 1)
